Jordan / Ben —

I reviewed the combined order bundle and produced a redline set attached. Highlights & asks for Elena/procurement:

- Exhibit A: consolidated usage tiers look fine but we need to:
  • Clarify whether the baseline 1,000,000 token commitment is per month or averaged quarterly. Our billing model treats commit as monthly; if they want averaging we need explicit language for true-up mechanics.
  • Define "burst" — proposed: auto-burst up to 25% for 10 consecutive minutes without pricing change; anything beyond triggers overage rates. If Stratiform requires approval-based bursting, cost will increase.
- SLA/Credits: We propose keeping standard +72 hour incident SLA language and a mapped credit table (see page 4). If procurement wants additional credits for extended incidents during the 18-month term, we'll need to scope caps.
- Data retention / audit logs: Stratiform requested 7 years in §9.2 — Redwood standard is 3 years, negotiable for enterprise customers subject to additional fees. Need confirmation.
- Indemnity: They removed reciprocal indemnity; Redwood prefers mutual indemnity with carveouts for open-source components.

I've attached RI_ExhibitA_Proposed_changes_20261116.docx (tracked changes). If Elena can accept the burst definition above and confirm retention, we can issue a clean copy for signature.

Attachments: (RI_ExhibitA_Proposed_changes_20261116.docx - Word, tracked changes)

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the tracked changes. We reviewed internally and have two counterpoints on Kimberly's note:

1) Burst: procurement insists on approval-based bursting for budgeting control. They will accept the auto-burst approach only if there is an administrative cap and pre-notification (we proposed 15-minute pre-notice) — otherwise they want manual approval.
2) Data retention: legal asks for 7 years due to regulatory needs for a subset of logs. Could Redwood provide a scoped exception (7 years for audit logs only, 3 years for other user data) with associated fees?

I've uploaded our counter-redline and included a DocuSign preparatory link for the current bundle so we can keep timeline tight: https://docusign.net/Stratiform/S-29384 (DocuSign_Stratiform_Orderbundle_Link.txt)
